title: Missing SafeERC20 Allows Silent Transfer Failures
description: All IERC20.transfer/transferFrom calls lack return value checks. No SafeERC20 used anywhere. If a token returns false instead of reverting, transfers silently fail. In _executeMint, this means actualReceived=0 and no require(actualReceived > 0) check exists.
impact: With non-standard tokens that return false, users could mint NFTs for free (actualReceived=0 but mint proceeds). Emergency withdrawals could silently fail.
attackPath: Protocol is configured with a token that returns false on failure instead of reverting
User calls mint() with insufficient balance or allowance
transferFrom returns false but execution continues
actualReceived is 0 but NFT is minted anyway
recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin SafeERC20 library for all ERC20 interactions. Replace transfer/transferFrom with safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom.
